title: Continuances.
bodyText: The military judge or a summary court-martial may for reasonable cause grant a continuance to any party for such time and as often as appears to be just.
bodyHtml: [§124B-65]  Continuances.  The military judge or a summary court-martial may for reasonable cause grant a continuance to any party for such time and as often as appears to be just. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
